controls.rule: core = drat-trim -c output on the unmodified text (read from a pipe, not stored); MUT-DROP drops the first core clause in CNF order, MUT-FLIP negates that clause's first literal; J-DROP drops J-family (officer/link) core clauses of (28,4) p0 in CNF order until the first rejection, at most 6 attempts, all recorded. The rule was fixed after an in-memory exploration showed that some single core-clause drops remain refutable by the same proof (redundant derivations), which is not a checker defect.

pins.not_copied: gz LRAT streams are read in place from the lane; the converter hashes the exact compressed bytes it streams

scope: Parent replay of the four e>0 engine-v5 proof-mode reports: profile completeness and Lemma 17 recomputed; every final CNF regenerated from V4_PROOF_SCHEMA.r2 (officer CNF, J, lex and composition written here; base from the pinned build_gen) and SHA-compared; each gz LRAT stream converted to addition-only RUP and checked by the pinned parent drat-trim -I -U.
